name: Blindness/Deafness
summary: Leaves a creature Blinded or Deafened unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw.

stats.effect: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the {ref:condition/blinded} or {ref:condition/deafened} condition (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.
